newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Approval of BA/AMR tie-up seen by spring.
newsitem.headline: Approval of BA/AMR tie-up seen by spring.

text.p: The chief executive of American Airlines said on Monday he expected regulatory approval for its tie-up with British Airways PLC would be completed by the end of March next year.
Robert Crandall, Chairman and President of the U.S. carrier, was speaking to Reuters during the annual general meeting of the global airlines body, the International Air Transport Association (IATA).
"I certainly think that the regulatory authorities will have aproved the tie-up ... by the end of the first quarter of 1997," he said.

"The approval process is moving along, but we would like to see it moving more quickly." Whenever it was completed, implementation of the link between the two air giants would take another three to five months, he added.
The tie-up was announced in the summer, but is under scrutiny by U.S. British and European Union authorities.
